title: Engineering Manager - Remote
location: Chicago, IL, Dallas, TX, Atlanta, GA
description: Back to jobs New Engineering Manager - Remote Remote/United States- Full-Time Apply FormativGroup is hiring an Engineering Manager to join a Financial Services technology organization that builds and maintains digital products for tax professionals. The team develops internal tools, financial dashboards, analytics, reporting solutions, and other technology that improves how client-serving professionals work. This is a hands-on Engineering Manager role for an experienced technical lead who wants to step into people leadership without stepping away from delivery. You will serve as both the senior technical authority and the people leader: contributing code, setting technical direction, reviewing work, strengthening engineering practices, and helping the team use AI agents effectively across the software development lifecycle. The environment includes legacy .NET/C# services and Angular front ends alongside newer Python, Node.js, and React development. You will help modernize the stack in phases while keeping business-critical components stable. What You'll Work On Lead from the keyboard: contribute production code regularly, use AI agents as part of day-to-day delivery, and stay close to the technical work. Own the team’s technical direction, architecture decisions, long-term technical health, and roadmap across new delivery, modernization, and technical debt. Lead phased modernization of legacy .NET/C# and Angular components while building new capabilities with Python, Node.js, and React. Break work into small, well-bounded tasks and route each task to the best executor - an engineer, an agent, or yourself - while keeping coordination lean and outcome-focused. Own pull request review and provide fast, technically substantive feedback. Build and manage the technical-debt backlog, resolving priority issues directly instead of relying only on delegation. Hire, evaluate, coach, and grow engineers; set the technical hiring bar and help the team work effectively with AI agents. Create and maintain agent operating instructions, verification protocols, and human-in-the-loop controls for code, tests, documentation, and infrastructure changes. Run evaluation checks before merge and retain human-owned merge control for production branches. Maintain strong automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, and uphold consistent engineering practices across design, coding, testing, release, and operations. Drive CI/CD automation, containerized delivery, and Infrastructure as Code for cloud-native applications. Track engineering health and delivery metrics, including required reporting through Atlassian Compass. Facilitate bi-weekly live demos from the cloud environment, including both product features and agent-enabled workflows. Partner with the dedicated production support organization by providing tooling, automation, documentation, and runbooks that make the product easier to operate and support. Reduce operational toil through automation while applying appropriate security guardrails, blast-radius limits, and audit trails to production-touching workflows. Maintain visibility into WIZ Critical and Major findings and drive remediation within required service levels. Keep architecture documentation, ADRs, runbooks, and agent instructions current and usable. What You'll Bring 5-7+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with clear experience as a senior engineer or technical lead and prior leadership of at least one engineering team. Hands-on full-stack development depth and the desire to continue building while managing engineers. Strong proficiency with Python, Node.js, and React for modern application development. Experience maintaining and modernizing .NET/C# services and Angular front ends. Demonstrated use of agentic or AI-assisted software development workflows in real delivery environments, not just experimentation. Ownership of the full development lifecycle: build, test, release, operate, troubleshoot, and iterate. Cloud-native application experience on Azure; AWS or GCP experience is also relevant. Hands-on experience with containerized workloads and orchestration. Infrastructure as Code experience with tools such as Bicep, Terraform, Pulumi, or AWS CDK. Strong automated testing and CI/CD experience across full-stack delivery. Ability to make significant technical contributions, solve complex engineering problems, and make sound architecture decisions. Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. How You Work You are a player-coach: comfortable owning people leadership while remaining an active practitioner. You use AI agents to increase engineering throughput, but you keep quality, testing, security, and production decisions under clear human control. You bring structure without creating unnecessary process and identify technical dependencies, delivery risks, and quality issues early. You are comfortable working in a small-team environment where priorities can shift and where leadership means doing the work as well as directing it. You balance modernization with stability and understand that business-critical systems must continue to perform while the architecture evolves. Additional Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required. Exposure to financial services, accounting, finance, tax technology, finance transformation, tax software development, or implementation environments. Ability to take ownership of assigned work through completion, including requirements, configuration, testing, debugging, and system/process changes. Bonus Points If You Have Relevant professional certifications or advanced degrees - such as CPA, EA, JD, or a master's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, information systems, engineering, quantitative economics, or a related field - are a plus, but not required. Familiarity with GitHub, GitHub Actions, Atlassian tools, SonarQube, Mend, Aqua Trivy, and WIZ. Experience with micro front-end architectures. Experience modernizing mixed legacy/new technology environments while continuing to ship. Experience building practical engineering guardrails for AI-assisted or agentic development. What Success Looks Like The team ships predictably while maintaining strong quality, testing, security, and release discipline. The Engineering Manager remains technically credible and materially contributes to delivery rather than operating only as a coordinator. Legacy components remain stable while modernization progresses in deliberate, low-risk increments. AI agents are used productively with clear verification, human review, and production controls. Engineers receive timely technical feedback, coaching, and clear expectations, and the team’s technical hiring bar remains high. Operational support improves through better automation, runbooks, documentation, and reduced manual toil. Why Join FormativGroup At FormativGroup, you'll work with people who are practical, collabroative, and focused on solving meaningful business and technology problems. We're growing, which means you'll have opportunities to contribute ideas, work closely with experienced leaders, and help shape how we deliver for our clients. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa currently. To be considered for this position, candidates must reside in one of the following U.S. states: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, TN, TX, VA, WI, and Washington DC. Candidates residing outside these states are not eligible for consideration currently. We are committed to pay equity and transparency. The compensation range for this position represents our good faith estimate of the range we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation offered will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, education, work location, and internal equity. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for discretionary bonuses, commissions, or other incentive programs, as well as a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, etc. Estimated Compensation Range: $190,000 - $210,000 USD FormativGroup operates within the critical middle layer of business technology, where applications and systems connect infrastructure to business processes. We are specialists who help the middle market take full advantage of their technology investments with deep, industry-centric expertise, all in one place, to unify fragmented systems. With deep technical expertise across cloud architecture, system integration, AI, and data strategy, we bridge the gap between business goals and modern platforms. How do you know if you have a disability? A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to: Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally) Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS Blind or low vision Cancer (past or present) Cardiovascular or heart disease Celiac disease Cerebral palsy Deaf or serious difficulty hearing Diabetes Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders Epilepsy or other seizure disorder Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome Intellectual or developmental disability Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD Missing limbs or partially missing limbs Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis (MS) Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities Partial or complete paralysis (any cause) Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema Short stature (dwarfism) Traumatic brain injury Disability Status Select...
